person_note: The authorized opening, explicit whole-book POV descriptions, and interior structural analysis consistently establish a nonparticipating omniscient third-person narrator. The longer Goodreads passages likewise narrate multiple characters externally. First- and second-person forms in the quote set occur only in dialogue, including the final farewell, and therefore do not indicate alternating base narration. Several short or clipped event quotes are conservatively unmarked, but no credible evidence suggests a participating narrator or sustained narration in another person.
